persona.name: Gunvor
persona.background: Smallholder and forest-worker family; father floats timber on Vindelälven in spring. One radio channel (Radiotjänst): Karusellen with Lennart Hyland, Frukostklubben with Sigge Fürst, Grammofontimmen, Sunday service. Accordion and gammaldans at the dansbana and Folkets hus, hymns and string-band songs at the missionshus, a wind-up gramophone at the neighbour's.

seeds.song: Harry Brandelius - Hur tokigt som helst
Lasse Dahlquist - De' ä' dans på Brännö brygga
The Andrews Sisters - Rum and Coca-Cola
Karl Gerhard - Den ökända hästen från Troja
The Soul Stirrers - Jesus Gave Me Water
Duke Ellington and His Orchestra - Take the 'A' Train
Anton Karas - The Third Man Theme

SE1953A.wouldSay: Snoddas, ja! Det där minns jag, pappa sjöng med. Men resten är ju beredskapstiden, mammas skivor från kriget, och sen den där negerjazzen och amerikansk kyrkosång har jag aldrig hört i hela mitt liv.
missing: Bertil Boo - Violer till mor, c.1948 (still everywhere)
SE1953A.fake: Only one song is actually from 1952-53; five are wartime (1931-41) evergreens and four are American jazz/gospel that never reached a Västerbotten kitchen radio (Parker's 'Confirmation' was not even released until 1954, I believe).
SE1953A.missingScene: The 1953 schlager year itself (Swedish covers of American and German hits), accordion/gammaldans (Calle Jularbo, Carl Jularbo-style dansbana music), and läsarsånger/free-church song (Lapp-Lisa, Einar Ekberg) which was the biggest music in rural Norrland.

seeds.song: Lasse Lönndahl - Sången från Moulin Rouge
Lasse Lönndahl - Ett vänligt litet ord

SE1953B.wouldSay: Ja, det här är Grammofontimmen! Valpen i fönstret sjöng vi på skolgården, och Snoddas förstås. Lasse Lönndahl kom väl lite senare för oss, men rösten känner jag igen direkt.
missing: Bertil Boo - Violer till mor, c.1948
SE1953B.fake: Right sound and all in Swedish, but it is Stockholm schlager only with Lönndahl three times, and three seeds look like 1954 records ('Ett vänligt litet ord' is 'Little Things Mean a Lot', 'That's Amore' and 'Mjölnarens Iréne' I place in 1954; unsure of exact release dates).
SE1953B.missingScene: Accordion and gammaldans from the dansbana, and free-church/string-band song (Lapp-Lisa, Einar Ekberg); no foreign original at all, though Swedes then mostly heard the Swedish covers anyway.

persona.name: Bengt
persona.background: Father a plater at Götaverken, mother a cleaner. Radio at home (Frukostklubben, Grammofontimmen, Karusellen), Radio Luxembourg at night on the older brother's set, jukebox at the café, Liseberg stage in summer, Bildjournalen pictures, 78s and the first EPs at a friend's. No TV at home yet.

seeds.song: Lasse Dahlquist - De' ä' dans på Brännö brygga
Karl Gerhard - Den ökända hästen från Troja
Jerry Lee Lewis - Great Balls of Fire
The Soul Stirrers - Touch the Hem of His Garment

SE1957A.wouldSay: Diana and Jailhouse Rock, yes, that was us boys at the café jukebox. Brännö brygga is Göteborg all right, but that's what my father sang, and Min soldat is from the war. Where are the Swedish records from that year? And who is this gospel group?
SE1957A.fake: No Swedish seed is from 1955-57: the local half is a 1931-41 evergreen shelf plus 1952 and 1954 hits, and the bebop, Miles Davis and Soul Stirrers tracks are records no shipyard family in Majorna owned.
SE1957A.missingScene: The 1957 Swedish schlager and cover scene (Lönndahl, Lily Berglund, Brita Borg), Swedish rock'n'roll (Rock-Ragge, Owe Thörnqvist, Little Gerhard), Knäppupp/Povel Ramel, and trad jazz/skiffle, which were what Göteborg youth actually had.

persona.name: Bengt
persona.background: Father a plater at Götaverken, mother a cleaner. Radio at home (Frukostklubben, Grammofontimmen, Karusellen), Radio Luxembourg at night on the older brother's set, jukebox at the café, Liseberg stage in summer, Bildjournalen pictures, 78s and the first EPs at a friend's. No TV at home yet.

seeds.song: Lasse Lönndahl - Man måste vara två
Lily Berglund - Kärlek, nål och tråd
Lily Berglund - Bär du solsken i ditt sinne

SE1957B.wouldSay: Kärleksbrev i sanden, that was on the radio every morning, my mother loved Lasse Lönndahl. Titta titta, and Rock-Ragge! This is the radio at home. But for me at twelve it was Elvis and Tommy Steele, and there's not one of them here.
SE1957B.fake: Authentic radio schlager, but it is the parents' and mother's half of 1957 with no foreign rock'n'roll originals at all, and 'Fat Mammy Brown' I place at 1959 rather than 1957 (unsure).
SE1957B.missingScene: Imported rock'n'roll and skiffle (Elvis, Tommy Steele, Little Richard, Paul Anka) that defined 1957 for anyone under 18; also Göteborg's own (Lasse Dahlquist, Sten-Åke Cederhök revue tradition) and trad jazz.

persona.name: Birgitta
persona.background: Father a fitter at ASEA, mother in a shop. Family got a TV in 1958 (Stora famnen, Melodifestivalen 1959); radio Frukostklubben and Grammofontimmen, Radio Luxembourg under the blanket, older sister's EPs, Bildjournalen, artists at Folkets park in Västerås, school dances.

seeds.song: Lill-Babs - Är du kär i mej ännu Klas-Göran?
Domenico Modugno - Nel blu, dipinto di blu

SE1959A.wouldSay: Klas-Göran! Åh, den kunde vi utantill, vi härmade Lill-Babs på rasterna. Och Varm korv boogie, och Augustin från Melodifestivalen på teve. Ja, det här är precis när jag var fjorton.
missing: Gunnar Wiklund - Nu tändas åter ljusen i min lilla stad, 1959
Elvis Presley - A Fool Such as I, 1959
Towa Carson - Banjo Boy? (1960, unsure) / Siw Malmkvist - Augustin, 1959
SE1959A.fake: Nothing false; it is only thin (seven seeds), and 'Diana' is two years old by 1959.
SE1959A.missingScene: Thore Skogman and the Folkets park dansband/gammaldans side, trad jazz ('dixie') that school youth were mad about, and the Elvis/Cliff/Tommy Steele originals.

seeds.song: Elvis Presley - (Now and Then There's) A Fool Such as I
Chris Barber's Jazz Band - Petite Fleur
Lily Berglund - Så kom våren till Tarina
Gunnar Wiklund - Nu tändas åter ljusen i min lilla stad

SE1959B.wouldSay: Rock-Fnykis, haha, pappa skrattade så han grät. Buona sera, Living Doll, och Augustin! Och Petite Fleur dansade vi tryckare till. Ja, så här lät det hemma, både mitt och mammas.
missing: Lill-Babs - Är du kär i mej ännu Klas-Göran?, 1959
Domenico Modugno - Nel blu, dipinto di blu, 1958
SE1959B.fake: Broad and correct, but the single biggest Swedish record of 1959 (Klas-Göran) and Varm korv boogie are absent, Lily Berglund fills three slots with lesser titles, and it opens on a 1957 comedy number (dates of the two Skogman titles unsure).
SE1959B.missingScene: Lill-Babs and Owe Thörnqvist as the teenage faces of the year; otherwise well covered (schlager, Skogman, trad jazz, Elvis/Cliff).
